feeds.title: My First 5K and More
feeds.description: Myself Darlene Cardillo. I was a lady in her 50's who was searching for the 'Fountain of Youth.' Along the way, I discovered RUNNING. Read my blog and you'll get to see how it all unfolds.

feeds.title: Still a Runner
feeds.description: A Blog by Mary Lou Harris where she shares about senior running, travel and related topics. Mary Lou writes about the adventures and misadventures of a senior runner, ultra trail runner, and hiker. She is an RRCA-accredited race director. Mary Lou Harris is a proponent of active living, community volunteerism, and inquisitive travel.

feeds.title: Running With Rick Blog
feeds.description: Running With Rick incorporates 50 years of current and past running experiences, including the impact it has had on my life and how to balance everything.

feeds.title: Running Thru Quicksand
feeds.description: Welcome to 'Running Thru Quicksand.' The author is a proud mom, wife, retired teacher, cross country, and track coach. Join her as she navigates life's curveballs and embraces being a strong woman in her 50s. Together, readers will learn, grow, and conquer whatever comes their way.

feeds.title: This Old Runner Blog
feeds.description: The author writes about learning to run half marathons as an adult. This blog tries to give inspiration to people who want to run irrespective of their age.

feeds.title: Chocolate Runs Judy
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Judy creator of Chocolaterunsjudy. Welcome to my little corner of the blogosphere, where I share my passion for running, chocolate, baking, and pretty much whatever else crosses my mind. I'm on a mission to run a half marathon in every US state & hopefully raise money for charities And to create a safe community for runners of any speed.

feeds.title: RunYoung50
feeds.description: Run Young 50 is all about women runners over 50. Find out more about what motivates older women to run and the history of women's distance running.

feeds.title: In Hope We Rise Blog
feeds.description: Francesca Alicea is on a mission is to inspire others to level up from the adversity and setbacks. Her blog, In Hope We Rise is a space for all of us who find strength and resilience in faith, and who long to ignite the spark of inspiration within ourselves and others.

feeds.title: Sherpaherb
feeds.description: Sherpaherb is a lifelong runner who is on a mission to help runners over 50 stays healthy and fit as they age through his Forever Runner Method. If you are a runner over 50 years old, lose weight and run faster without injury. A simple, low-stress way to long term fitness and health.

feeds.title: Wimpy Girl
feeds.description: Wimpy Girl is a webcomic that follows the life of a not-so-young woman who decides to start running. It is also a platform of encouragement for people who are brave enough to attempt new things and are willing to laugh and enjoy the journey!
